quantized versions of the four models

links.outcome: Fairness (mFARM score) across race x gender prompt variants under quantization and reduced context
links.effect: Most models kept robust mFARM scores across quantization levels but deteriorated significantly when context was reduced.
links.quote: We find that most models maintain robust performance in terms of $mFARM$ score across varying levels of quantization but deteriorate significantly when the context is reduced.

unlisted_practices: Multi-metric fairness assessment (allocational, stability, latent) aggregated into an mFARM score
Fairness-Accuracy Balance (FAB) score to detect models that are fair only because they are clinically inert

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a framework and dataset for evaluating multi-faceted fairness and bias in LLMs for clinical decision support (ED triage and opioid recommendation) across different quantization and context settings, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
